title: One Bedroom Apartment in Mount Pleasant (pet friendly)
address: corner of East Broadway & Prince Edward Street, Vancouver
desc:
This pet friendly, one-bedroom apartment in Vancouver is available for rent immediately. The cost is $1, 800 per month (plus the cost of utility, BC hydro).

Adrian Court Apartments is a small, family run business that has been in the Mount Pleasant community for over twenty-five years. There are only six apartment units in this two-storey building. 

With plenty of shops and parks nearby, we are conveniently located on the corner of East Broadway and Prince Edward Street. 

The unit available is the corner unit on the first floor with laminate flooring throughout. There are only two floors of the building. 

It is on first floor with lots of privacy, and features new appliances, and a newly remodelled bathroom (with a new and high end tub and shower). This apartment has also been freshly painted and professionally cleaned. 

Directly in front of the property is a bus stop at Westbound E Broadway @ Prince Edward St (ID: 50849) where #8 takes you Downtown and #9 to Granville Street. 

Across the street is Kingsgate Shopping Mall where there are ample stores and amenities including a barber, bank, pharmacy, grocer, community centre and liquor store. Along the street you will find more restaurants and businesses along the block including sushi, pho, pizza, and nail/hair salons. Guelph Park/ Dude Chilling is within walking distance (one block away). 

There is unrestricted parking along the side of the building (Prince Edward Street) as well as around the park. The closest laundry mat is approximately 450 metres away/ a 10 minute walk or a 4 minute drive.

The unit has a kitchen, bedroom with a large walk in closet, and full bathroom.

The kitchen has a double sink, pull out faucet, fridge/freezer, plenty of cabinets, electric stove/oven, with a range hood fan.

The bedroom is spacious with a window (that opens) and a ceiling fan. The doorknobs are all new. There is also a spacious walk in closet. The bedroom also comes with blinds/drapes as well as a magnetic screen (upon request).

The bathroom has a brand new full size soaker bathtub and shower.  There is also a medicine cabinet (new), sink, light fixture (new), shelf, and fan. 

We also have a small, covered common area behind the building. It has a bike storage area that is monitored with a security camera system that is kept locked.

There is also a large hot water tank that is dedicated to this unit. 

All applicants are required to fill out an application form where proof of income, character reference, and previous landlord references are checked. All applicants [and their pet(s)] must be able to meet in person to be considered. 

We are seeking long-term tenants. We offer a one-year fixed term lease which turns into a month to month tenancy afterwards. To give you an idea, the previous tenant lived in this unit for many years. Unfortunately, we are only able to accommodate non-smokers (of any kind) due to our current insurance policy. Our policy also requires tenants to have renter’s insurance. 

Although we are pet friendly, we require pet references to make sure your pet is healthy and the right fit (non-aggressive). As this is one of the few apartments in the area that are pet friendly, we are unable to accept any pet(s) that is/are aggressive to humans or other animals. Please consider that all tenants in this building have either a small cat and/or dog. We also require a pet deposit. and a separate pet policy to be signed (made by the SPCA).

There is only one utility at this property and it is BC Hydro. This is a traditional style apartment so each unit has their own dedicated hot water tank (nothing is shared) so the cost is dependent on usage.
